wants.topic: Hidden status / billionaire beggar marrying mistreated stepdaughter
wants.evidence: Arooj Narrate (vsNormal 143.06x, 89.35x, 62.66x) and Drama Basti (vsNormal 27.08x, 3.99x) titles showing massive viral spikes when stepmothers marry daughters off to beggars who hold secret identities.

wants.topic: Fateful stormy night / acts of kindness bridging class divides
wants.evidence: GK Hindi Stories 1m achieved 886.31x normal performance on 'poor girl giving water to thirsty traveler' and 90.03x on 'millionaire widow inviting shepherd on stormy night'.

wants.topic: Arrogant Zamindar / Royal authority humbled by pure rural love or mysterious talent
wants.evidence: Fictional Studio TV achieved 10.7x normal views on '100th night princess room' and high engagement on Zamindar pride shattered by flute/earth love stories.

wants.topic: Direct cliffhanger continuations (Part 2 / Part 3) of forced betrothals
wants.evidence: Drama Basti generated 3.2M views on 'PART 2' of the stepmother beggar story with 2,318 viewer comments explicitly seeking resolution.

gaps: Premchand-style grounded village family sagas that offer deep literary emotional resolution instead of pure shock-value sensationalism.
Stories exploring genuine sacrifice and hidden nobility without relying heavily on modern urban tropes.
saturated: Generic 'Showroom insult / humble person teaches lesson to rich salesman' tropes (Drama Basti vsNormal 0.08).
Standard 'Child returns after 25 years as IAS officer to take revenge' narratives (Drama Basti vsNormal 0.22).
Generic Aghori / horror room mysteries detached from family/romantic stakes (GK Hindi Stories vsNormal 0.01).
Routine daily religious adhyay recitations without seasonal festival hooks (FaKT Dharmik Katha vsNormal 0.01).
